post.text: A guard post blocks the only road across the border. Your papers are forged, and not well.

choices.text: Wait for nightfall by the river

river.text: Night falls. The river runs black and fast, and no one watches this side of it.

choices.text: Wait on the bank for a better moment

cell.text: The guard reads your papers twice, then calls for the captain. By morning you are in a cell: alive, unhurt, and a long way from the other side.

dawn.text: The better moment never comes. At dawn a patrol finds you shivering on the bank and walks you back to the post.

shore.text: You drag yourself onto the far bank, soaked and free. Behind you, the lamp of the guard post is a small orange dot.
